Vanessa / team — quick estimate based on their traffic profile and our performance assumptions:
- Latency constraint (p99 250ms) pushes toward A100-class instances for production.
- Rough serving footprint: ~48 A100-80GB-equivalent GPUs to meet concurrent streams with room for KV cache effectiveness and burst headroom. If we accept slightly higher p99 (~300–350ms) or use model quantization profile Q4-light, we can shave to ~36 GPUs.
- Suggested instance mix: 6 clusters of 8 x A100-80GB (preferred) or 8 clusters of 6 x A100 for more distributed failover.

Notes / assumptions: average session length ~4 min, batching efficiency at 1.8x due to prefix reuse, and model is Llama-2-70B-fp16 variant. I did not assume cross-region fallback.

I'll put detailed numbers into the capacity form and attach an inventory snapshot if Priyom can provide the real-time counts.

—Karthik

Vanessa — attached is the latest US-east inventory snapshot and a provisional hold proposal. Short summary:
- Current available A100-equivalent pool (projected for Oct–Dec, accounting for committed Dedicated contracts): 102 GPUs.
- Spare flexible capacity (can be converted to reserved): ~40 GPUs across 3 racks in us-east-1.
- Longer-lead procurement/reservation requests are 4–6 weeks to provision additional hardware if needed.

Provisional hold options:
1) Soft hold (30 days) — We flag 48 GPUs as "provisionally allocated" in our internal inventory tool; these can still be reassigned if a higher-priority enterprise commit appears, but sales is notified 72h in advance of any reallocation. No billing.
2) Committed short-term reserve (60 days minimum) — Requires signed MSA + 50% of first month as deposit; we move the inventory into a reserved pool and promise not to reassign. Standard reserved pricing applies (we can give 12% discount for Q4 pilot).

I attached gpu_inventory_snapshot.csv and a completed section of the capacity_hold_form for Karthik's numbers. If you want the hold to be express (no paperwork), we can initiate a soft hold today and start the legal/finance thread in parallel.

—Priyom
